assertions.expected: Constructor accepts a SymPy symbol as the coefficient and exposes it under the input term
In-place scalar multiplication sets the dummy operator's term coefficient to the SymPy symbol
Adding the negative symbolic coefficient removes the term from the exposed terms mapping
The transformed raising operator has two Pauli terms
The Z-string/X term has coefficient x/2
The Z-string/Y term has coefficient -ix/2
The full transformed operator equals the sum of those two Pauli terms
Tree-pattern X/Z term of the lowering operator has coefficient x/2
Tree-pattern Y/X/Z term of the lowering operator has coefficient ix/2
Corresponding raising Y/X/Z term has coefficient -ix/2
Corresponding raising X/Z term has coefficient x/2
The transformed raising-plus-lowering sum has one Pauli term
That sum is the expected X/Z Pauli term with coefficient x
Constructor stores one term for a tuple input with a complex coefficient
The exposed term coefficient equals the supplied complex value
In-place scalar multiplication applies the complex multiplier to the dummy operator's term
Adding a different term produces two stored terms
The original term keeps coefficient 1
The new term has coefficient 0.5
Adding the same second term again does not increase the term count
The original term remains unchanged
The repeated term's coefficients add to 1
The transformed mode-3 raising operator has two Pauli terms
Its Z-string/X term has coefficient 0.5
Its Z-string/Y term has coefficient -0.5i
The full transform equals the sum of the expected Pauli terms
Raising operator has two Pauli terms
Lowering operator has two Pauli terms
The specified Majorana component has logarithmic qubit locality
Mode-9 lowering has the expected X/Z Pauli-string coefficient 0.5
Mode-9 lowering has the expected Y/X/Z Pauli-string coefficient 0.5i
Mode-9 raising has the expected Y/X/Z coefficient -0.5i
Mode-9 raising has the expected X/Z coefficient 0.5

rationale: DummyOperator1 tests check type acceptance, generic coefficient arithmetic, or exposed term removal. The transform tests check exact Pauli strings and coefficients and are quantum semantic. Each test has one primary label.
